_comment: Copy this file to common.local.json and adjust for your home. common.local.json is ignored by git and OVERRIDES dashboard-config.default.json, common.json, and tasks.json. Delete any key you do not need to override. See docs/config-and-home-assistant.md for what belongs in config vs Home Assistant.

homeAssistant._comment: BINDINGS: point Nova at the specific Home Assistant entities for this home. Weather/sun auto-detect (weather.* / sun.sun) usually work out of the box.
homeAssistant._comment_structural: STRUCTURAL: things Home Assistant cannot express. Which HA areas are organisational (climate/network groupings) rather than rooms, and which entities to leave out of the aggregate Home zone.
homeAssistant._comment_classification: OVERRIDES (escape hatches): prefer doing this in Home Assistant instead. Add a label to a device in HA, assign sensors to areas, or set entity_category. Only list entity ids here when HA metadata is missing or wrong.

dashboard._comment_lighting: LIGHTING POLICY: opinions about how individual fixtures behave inside zone lighting actions. intensityThresholds map any lighting-layer entity (a real light, or a switch promoted with the nova_illumination label / forceIlluminationEntityIds) to an on/off-only fixture that only turns on when the zone is set at or above thresholdPct — useful for a switched outlet (e.g. neon) with no dimming. entityPresets pin a fixture to a fixed look: set pinned=true so it ignores the zone's brightness/colour and is always (re)driven to targetBrightnessPct + colorTemperatureOverrideKelvin, reapplied on every manual edit and by the scheduled poller (e.g. a conservatory kept warm-white at full brightness). ~3000K is warm white; ~6500K is cool/bright white.
